Initial release of phy-ai-context-gen: generate project-specific AI assistant context files for five major tools.

- Analyzes the full codebase to detect tech stack, frameworks, conventions, and testing setup.
- Generates context/instructions files for Claude (CLAUDE.md), OpenClaw/Codex (AGENTS.md), Cursor (.cursorrules), Windsurf (.windsurfrules), and GitHub Copilot (.github/copilot-instructions.md).
- Produces non-generic, accurate content based on actual project files and conventions.
- Provides clear instructions for each file format and ensures existing context files are not overwritten without confirmation.
- Designed to streamline onboarding and AI setup, saving 30–60 minutes of manual work per project.
